name: Shotstack
summary: Render videos, images and audio from a JSON timeline or saved template, generate AI assets, and inspect media.

stage.description: v1 for production (no watermark), stage for the development sandbox. Each environment has its own API key.

api_key.description: A Shotstack API key for the chosen environment (v1 or stage), from the Shotstack dashboard. Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Rendering is asynchronous: render calls return an id; poll shotstack.render.get until status is done (or failed) and read url. Or pass a callback URL in the body.

Production rendering is billed per minute of rendered video from the plan's minutes; rendering pauses when minutes run out. The stage sandbox is free but watermarked. AI generation is charged in credits per model.
A key works only on the environment (v1 or stage) it was issued for.
Rendered file URLs from the status call are temporary; the Serve API (shotstack.assets.by_render) holds the hosted copies.

endpoints.name: Render an edit
endpoints.summary: Queues a render of a JSON timeline (tracks, clips, assets) to video, image or audio; returns a render id.

timeline.description: The edit: background, fonts, soundtrack and tracks of clips (each clip has an asset, start and length in seconds).

output.description: Output format and size, e.g. {format: mp4, resolution: sd}. Except for mp3, give resolution or size (width and height); custom sizes up to 3840 px a side.

merge.description: Placeholder replacements: [{find: NAME, replace: Jane}] fills {{NAME}} in the timeline.

callback.description: Webhook URL notified when the render completes or fails.

notes: A read over POST that spends plan minutes on v1 (per minute of output). Poll shotstack.render.get with the returned response.id.

endpoints.name: Get render status
endpoints.summary: Status, temporary asset URL and details of a render.

data.description: Include the original timeline and output in the answer; currently defaults to true but will default to false.

merged.description: With data=true, show merge fields merged into the data.

endpoints.name: List templates
endpoints.summary: Templates saved on the account for the current environment.

endpoints.name: Render a template
endpoints.summary: Queues a render of a saved template with merge-field values; returns a render id.
notes: A read over POST that spends plan minutes like a render. Poll shotstack.render.get with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Inspect a media file
endpoints.summary: FFprobe metadata (width, height, duration, frame rate, rotation, streams) for any public image, video or audio URL.

url.description: The media URL; it is URL-encoded into the path.

endpoints.name: Generate an AI image, video or audio asset
endpoints.summary: One asset from a prompt (or a source file for some models), without rendering an edit.

asset.description: {type: image|video|audio, prompt, model, options, src}. Default models: nano-banana-2 (image), seedance-2.0-text-to-video (video), elevenlabs-multilingual-v2 (audio).

example.prompt: A lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset

length.description: Seconds of clip the asset fills, for models that generate to a duration.

idempotency_key.description: Makes this request its own generation; retrying with the same key returns the first job instead of billing again.

notes: A read over POST billed in credits per asset; identical repeat requests (same prompt, model, options) come from the cache free. Queued jobs are polled at shotstack.asset.status. List models and options with shotstack.models.list.

endpoints.name: Get generation status
endpoints.summary: Status and, when done, the public URL of a generated asset.

id.description: Generation job id from the generate call.

endpoints.name: List generation models
endpoints.summary: AI models for image, video and audio generation, with availability on this plan.

expand.description: options to include each model's option schema.

notes: Offer only models marked available. POST /generate/quote gives a credit estimate for an asset.

endpoints.name: Get hosted assets for a render
endpoints.summary: The hosted files (video, thumbnail, poster) a render produced, on the Serve API.
